electron.source: electron (the negatively charged subatomic particles that orbit atoms)

elip.source: ellipse the locus of a point such that the sum of the distances from that point to two other fixed points is constant; equivalently, the conic section that is the intersection of a cone with a plane that does not intersect the base of the cone; ellipsis the removal from a phrase of a word which is grammatically needed, but which is clearly understood without having to be stated

em-xi.source: A rapper; the midheaven or highest point in the sky. Contrasted to Imum Coeli
